facts: SPDK explains why assigning mutable state to a thread and passing messages can avoid shared-state lock contention.
SPDK components can be integrated into an application runtime; describing SPDK reactors does not prove an application uses its event framework.
Queue ownership and CPU locality are general storage-engine design principles, not by themselves evidence of Lavik implementation.
